module.name: Structural Assisted Intelligence
module.summary: Minimal model-independent structural reasoning kernel implementing RTT as executable grammar.
module.purpose: Provide a small, inspectable, scarcity-first substrate in which useful reasoning can emerge from observation, operators, state, and provenance before any model is introduced.

observation.role: Entry of any input with identity, content, provenance, order, and status.

operator_kernel.role: Small canonical operator set that transforms structure.
operator_kernel.invariant: Operators may transform structure. They may not invent evidence.

triadic_observer.role: Maintains claim / counterstate / observer and emits structural statuses.

memory.role: Persistent history of observations, relations, operations, and resulting states.

interface.role: Primitive status reporting. Natural language deferred to LMA.
interface.invariant: Unknown is a valid, stable, successful result.

RELATE.description: Declare or detect a connection between observations or states.

RESOLVE.description: Attempt resolution of an unresolved structure.

STABILIZE.description: Dampen or lock a coherent state.

RECALL.description: Retrieve prior observation, relation, or path.

invariants: Unknown is a valid stable state.
No model dependency for core function.
Design under scarcity from day one.
Experimental layers may not rewrite kernel invariants.
Self-generated evidence is not independent validation.
A claimed improvement does not become authoritative merely because it scores higher.
Mutation must remain attributable and reversible.
Past lineage is immutable; future lineage is branchable.
Accepted does not mean permanently preferred.
Forward does not inherently mean improvement.
Backward does not inherently mean failure.
Branching does not inherently mean incoherence.

architecture.separation: SAI remains the authority on state, relations, coherence, provenance, and uncertainty. LMA is a surrounding map of language resources. Experimental layers may operate through SAI but do not inherit authority over the kernel.

architectural_boundaries.principle: Kernel stable. History immutable. Future branchable. Evaluator declared. Lineage preserved. Operator sovereign.

rsi_sandbox.name: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement Sandbox
rsi_sandbox.purpose: Provide an inspectable educational environment for representing, proposing, evaluating, comparing, accepting, rejecting, recording, revisiting, and branching bounded improvement claims without granting recursive authority over the SAI kernel.
rsi_sandbox.principle: SAI can host an RSI experiment without becoming an RSI system.

rsi_re_ignition.name: RSI Re-Ignition
rsi_re_ignition.purpose: Allow a previously stabilized state to become a new point of bounded inquiry without deleting, overwriting, or invalidating subsequent lineage.
rsi_re_ignition.principle: Regression is not rollback. Rollback restores. Regression reopens.
rsi_re_ignition.history_rule: Past lineage is immutable. Future lineage is branchable.
rsi_re_ignition.improvement_rule: Accepted does not mean permanently preferred.

forward.description: Continue experimental inquiry from the currently stabilized state.

backward.description: Return analytically to a previously stabilized state as a candidate point for renewed inquiry.

lateral.description: Establish a new experimental branch from a previously stabilized state while preserving the original lineage.

rollback.description: Restore a prior known state because the present state is invalid, unsafe, corrupted, or unwanted.

regression.description: Select an earlier valid structural state as a new point of inquiry without erasing later history.

direction_principles: Forward does not inherently mean improvement.
Backward does not inherently mean failure.
Branching does not inherently mean incoherence.
rsi_re_ignition.educational_principle: A branch can fail as an improvement and succeed as evidence.

resources.title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement Sandbox
resources.description: Canonical description of the bounded RSI educational experiment, its authority boundaries, recursion levels, evaluation structure, drift controls, lineage requirements, and rollback requirements.

resources.title: RSI Re-Ignition
resources.description: Student- and AI-facing research note defining recursive regression, branching, Re-Ignition, and navigable experimental lineage while preserving immutable history and kernel boundaries.
